---
title: "Issues"
---

This page tracks the current public follow-up issues for the OrPen SC PDK workflow. It mirrors the development-feature split: two `gsim` feature candidates plus one SGB input-contract dependency.

## Active Issue Clusters

| Cluster | Owner | Done when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SGB input contract | `semantic_geometry_builder`, consumed by `gsim` where needed | Route A/B/C notebooks preserve terminal, interface, and physical-group identity without being presented as native `gsim` behavior. |
| Slurm HPC handoff package | `gsim` | Public notebooks can generate reviewable run folders, sbatch scripts, metadata sidecars, and handoff archives without submitting jobs. |
| Resolve/Results | `gsim` | Public notebooks can resolve completed Palace run folders and show C-matrix, domain-E, surface-Q, and convergence through typed reports. |

## Boundary Ledgers

| Ledger | Use |
| --- | --- |
| CAD/mesh identity provenance | SGB semantic identity context. |
| Palace report ownership | Resolve/Results ownership details for report loading and display semantics. |
| Palace config ownership | Config-generation identity decisions that affect SGB, Slurm handoff packaging, or Resolve/Results. |
| Public problem-type notebook coverage | Public notebook evidence for the two `gsim` feature candidates. |
